faqs.q: How long before I see results from SEO in Denmark?
faqs.a: Expect early movement in 2 to 3 months and solid results in 4 to 6. Copenhagen's competitive terms take longer; Aarhus, Odense, and Aalborg usually move faster because fewer local businesses invest in proper Danish-language SEO.

faqs.q: Is Danish really necessary? Everyone here speaks English.
faqs.a: For local customers, yes. Danes search in Danish for local services, and Google Denmark ranks Danish content for those queries. English works for international B2B, but a local business ranking in English is leaving most of its market on the table.

faqs.q: What is the single biggest local SEO win in Denmark?
faqs.a: A fully completed Google Business Profile in Danish, with correct categories, services, photos, and a steady flow of reviews. Most Danish competitors have half-finished profiles, so doing this properly often jumps you past them within weeks.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses outside Copenhagen?
faqs.a: Absolutely. In many ways those are the best projects: real search demand in Aarhus, Odense, and Aalborg with much thinner SEO competition than the capital. Some of the fastest page-one wins I have seen are in Denmark's second-tier cities.

One short monthly report in plain language: rankings that moved, calls or enquiries attributed, what I did, and what is next. You will never need an SEO dictionary to understand where your money went.
